_how_to_use: Organisations hiring on their own careers pages, shown as 'Hiring now' cards on /jobs/. Use this for employers whose jobs don't have their own links, or whose careers sites can't be pulled in automatically. One entry per organisation. 'id' is short, lowercase, letters, numbers and dashes. 'org_type' is one of: healthcare, social-community, government, education, charity. 'areas' uses the nature-of-work ids from the board's filters (social-work, counselling, clinical-psychology, psychology, case-management, youth-work, allied-health, nursing-care, special-needs, community-programmes, research-policy, admin-ops). 'roles' lists a few example roles in your own words. 'checked' is the date you last opened the careers page and saw relevant openings (YYYY-MM-DD). A card hides by itself 120 days after 'checked', so update the date whenever you re-check.
